Company profile

Caterpillar Inc., trading under the ticker CAT, is the world's leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines, and diesel-electric locomotives. Operating through key segments including Construction Industries, Resource Industries, and Energy & Transportation, the company also provides specialized financing and related services through its financial products arm. 

The company's origins trace back to 1925 with the merger of the Holt Manufacturing Company and C.L. Best Tractor Co., uniting to form the Caterpillar Tractor Co. The enterprise pioneered the development of track-type tractors, which proved instrumental in transforming agriculture, infrastructure development, and military logistics during the twentieth century. Headquartered in Deerfield, Illinois, Caterpillar has evolved into a global industrial titan, supporting customers across infrastructure, resource extraction, and energy sectors worldwide.
